skill.name: supabase
skill.description: Navigate Empathy Ledger Supabase tables, relationships, and common query patterns without connecting to the database.
skill.summary: Schema reference for Empathy Ledger Supabase tables, relationships, and query patterns.
skill.author: Acurioustractor

security_audit.summary: The code execution and network alerts are false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline code, and schema text. The relationship maps and sample queries do expose detailed internal Supabase schema, which is a low-risk reconnaissance concern if published broadly. No prompt injection, secret exfiltration, or executable malware behavior was found.

remediation.suggestion: Publish this skill only for intended project users, or redact sensitive table names, auth relationships, and tenant structure before listing it publicly.
Keep examples clearly labeled as SQL or TypeScript documentation and avoid ambiguous shell-style snippets in Markdown.

content.value_statement: Supabase projects can be hard to query when table relationships are spread across files. This skill gives concise schema maps and query patterns for Empathy Ledger.
actual_capabilities: Explains the main Empathy Ledger Supabase table groups and their purposes.
Maps foreign key relationships across tenants, profiles, stories, transcripts, and media tables.
Shows common SQL and Supabase query patterns for story and theme data.
Highlights tenant isolation expectations for database queries.
Points users to reference files for table lists and relationship diagrams.
limitations: It does not connect to Supabase or run database queries.
It reflects the bundled schema notes and may not match a changed live database.
It does not validate migrations, policies, permissions, or production data.
It is specific to the Empathy Ledger schema.

use_cases.title: Understand data relationships
use_cases.description: Review how stories, transcripts, profiles, tenants, and media assets connect before writing a query.

use_cases.title: Plan reporting queries
use_cases.description: Find the tables and joins needed for story counts, theme summaries, and organization dashboards.

use_cases.title: Check tenant boundaries
use_cases.description: Use the documented tenant isolation pattern when reviewing Supabase query logic.

prompt_templates.title: Find the right table
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the supabase skill to identify which Empathy Ledger tables store stories, transcripts, and storyteller profile data.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a relationship path
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the supabase skill to explain how profiles, storytellers, stories, transcripts, and analysis results relate to each other.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a query approach
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the supabase skill to outline a safe query approach for listing published stories with theme names and storyteller details.

prompt_templates.title: Review tenant isolation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the supabase skill to review whether this Supabase query plan includes tenant isolation and the needed relationship joins.

output_examples.input: Which tables connect a storyteller to published stories and transcripts?
output_examples.output: The skill would describe the profile to storyteller to story to transcript path, then note related analysis tables for themes and quotes.

output_examples.input: How should I think about tenant isolation for story queries?
output_examples.output: The skill would explain that tenant filtering is expected and should be applied before returning story records.

output_examples.input: What reference should I open for the complete relationship map?
output_examples.output: The skill would direct the user to the relationship diagram reference and summarize the relevant section.

best_practices: Verify the bundled schema against the live database before shipping application changes.
Apply tenant filters to user-facing queries and review row level security separately.
Use the relationship map to plan joins before asking the model to draft query logic.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the examples as production-ready queries without permission review.
Do not use this skill as proof that a migration or policy is correct.
Do not publish private schema details unless the project owner approves public disclosure.

faq.question: Does this skill connect to my Supabase project?
faq.answer: No. It is a static schema reference and does not open network connections.

faq.question: Can it run SQL queries?
faq.answer: No. It can help plan query structure, but it does not execute SQL.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is the schema generic Supabase documentation?
faq.answer: No. It is tailored to the Empathy Ledger database model.

faq.question: Does it include row level security policies?
faq.answer: It mentions tenant isolation expectations, but it does not fully document or validate policies.

faq.question: What should I verify before using the examples?
faq.answer: Confirm table names, relationships, tenant filters, and permissions against the current database.
